acceptance: Red test first: a contract row whose agent leaves a daemon child that holds stdout returns within 15 s, not at the package timeout.
The tmux -L row passes 5 runs in a row with -count=1 and the integration tag.
No row leaves a tmux server alive after the test.
fix: Set cmd.WaitDelay on the command in contractHost.agent so Wait returns after the context ends even when a grandchild holds the pipe. Kill the private tmux -L server of the row in the row cleanup.
notes: Test-only change. The tripwire signal sender stays.
source: console, 2026-10-27, CI run on PR #1193 (macOS attempt 1)
summary: CI macOS on PR #1193 timed out in TestAgentSandboxContract/start_a_private_tmux_server_(-L). contractHost.agent (go/internal/bridge/sandbox_contract_integration_test.go:369) calls CombinedOutput under a 10 s context with no cmd.WaitDelay. The agent starts a daemon tmux -L server that keeps the output pipe open, so Wait blocks until the 20 minute package timeout. A rerun was green.
title: The sandbox contract test agent call has a WaitDelay, so a daemon tmux server in the agent cannot hang the package for 20 minutes
